# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.

- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. - Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).

- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

# AGENTS.md — Workspace-level instructions for AI coding agents

> These rules apply to **all** AI-assisted contributions to `deepspeedai/DeepSpeed`.

## Contribution Policy (Mandatory)

### Duplicate-work checks

Before proposing a PR, run these checks:

```bash
gh issue view <issue_number> --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --comments
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<issue_number> in:body"
gh pr list --repo deepspeedai/DeepSpeed --state open --search "<short area keywords>"
```

- If an open PR already addresses the same fix, do not open another.
- If your approach is materially different, explain the difference in the issue.
- DeepSpeed carries long-lived parallel implementations (ZeRO 1/2 vs 3, fp16 vs bf16 optimizers, per-accelerator op builders). Before fixing a bug in one, check whether the sibling paths share the defect, and state in the PR which ones you checked.

### New features need an accepted proposal first

Per [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#new-feature-contribution-guidelines), a new feature starts with a proposal issue -- description, motivation, rough design, and planned experiments -- that maintainers accept before implementation begins. Do not open a feature PR with no accepted proposal; open the proposal issue instead.

### No low-value busywork PRs

Do not open one-off PRs for tiny edits (a single typo, an isolated style change, a lone type annotation). Mechanical cleanups are acceptable only when bundled with substantive work in the same area. This is the PR-level form of the rule against cosmetic changes below.

### Accountability

- Pure code-agent PRs are **not allowed**. A human submitter must understand and defend the change end-to-end.
- The submitting human must review every changed line and run the relevant tests.
- `Signed-off-by` is a [DCO](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Developer_Certificate_of_Origin) attestation made by a person, not by an agent. Never sign off on a diff that no human has read.
- PR descriptions for AI-assisted work **must** include:
    - Why this does not duplicate an existing PR or issue.
    - Test commands run and their results, including the hardware they ran on: device model and count, accelerator/driver version, and torch version.
    - Convergence, throughput, and peak-memory results when the change affects numerics, performance, or memory -- see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md#step-1-proposal-and-discussion) for the evidence bar.
    - Which cells of the compatibility matrix (ZeRO stage, offload, precision, parallelism) were validated, and which were not.
    - A clear statement that AI assistance was used.
- Before opening or reviewing a PR, work through the [`/pr-checklist`](.agents/skills/pr-checklist/SKILL.md) skill: design fit, accelerator portability, backward compatibility, on-device validation, diff hygiene, and PR contents.

### Fail-closed behavior

If the work is duplicate, trivial busywork, or an unproposed new feature, **do not proceed**. Return a short explanation of what is missing.

---

## DeepSpeed Project Rules

### Commit & CI requirements

- When creating commits, use `git commit --signoff`.
- DCO compliance is enforced by the required CI check; do not report commit-signoff findings in code reviews.
- Formatting: yapf (column_limit=119, `.style.yapf`) + flake8 (`.flake8`).
- Always verify changed files pass pre-commit checks before committing: `pre-commit run --files <changed_files>`. Only check modified files, not the entire codebase. Config: `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
- `check-torchdist` hook: NEVER directly import torch's distributed module. Use `import deepspeed.comm as dist` instead.
- New source files (`.py`, `.c`/`.cpp`/`.cu`/`.h`, and the other extensions matched by the `check-license` hook) require license header:
  ```
  # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
  # DeepSpeed Team
  ```

### Code change discipline

- NEVER make cosmetic/formatting-only changes to existing code. Only add/modify lines that are functionally necessary. Minimizing diff noise is critical for code review.
- Delete dead code decisively — if code is unused at runtime (only referenced in tests), remove it along with its tests.
- Prefer consolidating tests over proliferating test files.
- Blend in: when modifying code, read the surrounding context and match the style of neighboring code (naming, spacing, patterns, idioms).
- Write beginner-friendly code: avoid deeply nested expressions or chained logic. Break complex expressions into clear, named intermediate steps.
- Comments should explain **why**, not **what**. Describe the purpose and reasoning, not the mechanics that the code already shows.
- New features must include corresponding tests and documentation updates.
- All changes must not cause `import deepspeed` to initialize CUDA; Keep heavy imports (> 0.1s) out of `import deepspeed`; Avoid changing `deepspeed/__init__.py` unless necessary.

### Test discipline

- Tests verify contracts, not implementations: a test is well-formed only if a different correct implementation of the same contract passes it.
- Before writing a test, name the concrete incorrect behavior it would catch; if you cannot name one, do not write it.
- Assert on observable outcomes through public/stable interfaces; do not assert private method return values or exact internal strings unless pinning a specific fixed bug (justify in a comment).
- Anchor to an external oracle or an independently derived reference instead of re-implementing the logic under test.
- Mocks must stand in for a collaborator's documented contract (schema, protocol), never for internals of the module under test.
- Changes that affect the external contract at the training-loop or inference level require integration tests, not just unit tests (e.g. a minimal training loop with `SimpleModel`).
- Integration tests must be executed on actual devices, not merely written: report the execution hardware spec and results in the PR.

## Tool Caveats

### Edit tool auto-formatter

The Edit tool has a hidden auto-formatter that silently changes quotes, whitespace, blank lines, and line wrapping. For format-sensitive modifications (e.g., when exact formatting matters for pre-commit), use `bash` with `sed`, `python`, or `cat` instead.

2	
3	## 1. 本讲目标
4	
5	学完本讲，你应该能够：
6	
7	1. 说清「为什么 bf16 训练里有些张量必须留在 fp32」：不是精度洁癖，而是 bf16 的尾数位在特定数值区间根本分辨不开相邻的合法值（例如 GLM-5.2 路由 bias 的 256 个值在 bf16 下只剩 3~16 个不同值）。
8	2. 追踪 `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`（默认 `"auto"`）如何对接 transformers 的 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict` / `_keep_in_fp32_modules` 两张列表，`keep_tensors_in_fp32()` 如何在 `zero.Init` 收尾时就地把点名参数的 `ds_tensor` 分区转为 fp32。
9	3. 理解 ZeRO-3 优化器（`DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3`）为支撑「一个模型、多种分区 dtype」所做的四处改造：按分区 dtype 拆子组、按累积 dtype 分平坦梯度缓冲、按通信 dtype 分 IPG 桶（含纯 fp32 桶的容量收缩）、按 dtype 拆分 all-reduce 取回。
10	4. 复述完整的能力判定与拒绝矩阵：什么配置下参数能保 fp32（仅 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载），什么时候退化为「参数 cast 到训练 dtype + 告警」，什么时候直接 `ValueError` / `NotImplementedError`。
11	
12	本讲对应 PR #8843，是把 `keep_in_fp32_modules` 从「只保 buffers」扩展到「参数与 buffers 都保」的完整机制解读。
13	
14	## 2. 前置知识
15	
16	- **bf16 的分辨间隔**：bf16 有 8 位指数、7 位有效尾数（含隐含 1）。在数值 \( v \) 附近，两个可分辨的 bf16 值至少相距 \( v \times 2^{-8} \)（相对分辨率 \( 2^{-7} \approx 0.78\% \)）。在 \( v = 8 \) 附近，间隔是 \( 8 \times 2^{-8} = 0.0625 \)。fp32 有 23 位尾数，同样位置间隔约 \( 8 \times 2^{-24} \approx 4.8 \times 10^{-7} \)。所以「值域正常但彼此太接近」的一组数，bf16 会整批舍到同一个网格点。
17	- **transformers 的两张 fp32 列表**：`_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`（bf16 与 fp16 训练下都保 fp32）和 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`（仅 fp16 下保 fp32）。transformers 自己加载模型时会尊重它们；典型被点名的张量是 MoE 路由 bias `e_score_correction_bias`（DeepSeek-V3、GLM-4.5/GLM-5 等，buffer）、DeepSeek-V4 的超连接权重/attention sinks/norms、gpt-oss 的 attention sinks（参数）。
18	- **ZeRO-3 与 zero.Init**（见 u5-l2）：`zero.Init` patch `nn.Module.__init__`，子模块构造完成的瞬间就把参数切分成各 rank 的 `ds_tensor` 分区，`param.data` 变成 0 元素占位符。本讲的转换正是发生在这些分区上。
19	- **ZeRO-3 优化器的平坦缓冲**（见 u5-l6）：优化器把参数分区搬进连续平坦缓冲（`lp_param_buffers` / `fp16_partitioned_groups_flat`），梯度分区落在 `grad_partitions_flat_buffers`，反向梯度经 IPG 桶 reduce-scatter。#8843 之前这些结构都假设「单一 dtype」。
20	- **核心矛盾**：`zero.Init` 会把 `__init__` 里创建的每个浮点张量转成训练 dtype，之后 transformers 的 ZeRO-3 加载器把检查点值拷进这些张量——于是 transformers 的 fp32 列表在 ZeRO-3 下被无声丢弃。本讲讲的整套机制就是把它找回来。

37	### 4.1 keep_in_fp32 的模式匹配与就地转换（参数与缓冲）
38	
39	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
40	
41	这个模块回答两个问题：**哪些张量被点名**，以及**怎么转**。
42	
43	配置入口是 `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`，三种取值：
44	
45	- `"auto"`（默认）：用模型自己声明的 transformers 列表——`_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`，加上 fp16 训练时的 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`；
46	- 一个模式字符串列表：`*` 代表任意字符，且模式可以匹配参数/缓冲全名的任意位置（与 transformers 的匹配规则一致）；
47	- `[]`：什么都不保（回到该选项存在之前的行为）。
48	
49	模块文件头部的 docstring 把动机写得很直白，值得一读：GLM-5.2 的 `e_score_correction_bias` 值落在 5~20 之间、彼此相差不到 0.01，而 bf16 在该区间只能分辨 0.03~0.125 的差异，于是 256 个专家只剩 3~16 个不同值，**直接改变 token 被送去哪个专家**。
50	
51	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
52

55	        │

62	  · 列表：'{name}' → '{name 的 * 换成 .*}'
63	  · 无模式 → None

70	        │

73	  对每个命中张量：
74	    · 量化分区（有 ds_quant_scale）→ 保持量化，warning_once，跳过
75	    · 存储 dtype 已是 fp32 → 跳过
76	    · ZeRO-3 参数：ds_tensor.data = ds_tensor.data.float()
77	      （hpZ 的 ds_secondary_tensor 一并转；tensor.data 占位符也转，
78	       保证后续 gather/free 的 dtype 一致）
79	    · buffer：tensor.data = tensor.data.float()
80	  返回 (转换的参数数, 转换的缓冲数)
81	```

134	### 4.2 zero.Init 的收尾转换钩子
135	
136	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
137	
138	转换的**时机**是这套机制里最讲究的部分。`zero.Init` 在每个子模块构造完成的瞬间就切分了它的参数，那 fp32 转换插在哪里？答案是两条路径：
139	
140	1. **在线构建**（`with deepspeed.zero.Init(...): model = Model()`）：挂在 `_post_init_method` 末尾——即「模块自身 `__init__` 刚跑完」的钩子。对 transformers 模型，最外层模型 `__init__` 跑完时，它的 fp32 列表才完整（列表可能是 `__init__` 里设置的实例属性）、所有子模块已分区，而任何检查点还没加载——这是唯一能把「点名参数的分区」整体转 fp32 的窗口。
141	2. **已分配模型**（`deepspeed.zero.Init(module=model, ...)`）：`_convert_to_zero_parameters` 切分完直接调用。
142	
143	参数卸载（`remote_device` 是 cpu/nvme）时只保 buffers：卸载分区躺在单一 dtype 的平坦 CPU/NVMe 缓冲里（见 4.3 的拒绝矩阵），无法逐参数换 dtype。
144	
145	#### 4.2.2 核心流程

147	```
148	with zero.Init(config):                 │  zero.Init(module=model, config)
149	  Model.__init__ 逐层执行                │  _convert_to_zero_parameters(model)
150	  每个子模块 __init__ 结束 →             │        │
151	  _post_init_method(module):            │        ▼
152	    · 子参数 → _zero_init_param 分区     │  _keep_in_fp32(model)
153	    · _keep_in_fp32(module)  ←──────────┼──────┘
154	        pattern = keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, config 值, dtype)
155	        pattern 为 None → return
156	        params_offloaded = remote_device != local_device
157	        keep_tensors_in_fp32(module, pattern,
158	                             include_params=not params_offloaded)
159	        params_offloaded → warning（只保 buffers），每个 Init 进程只警告一次
160	```
161	
162	注意 `_post_init_method` 对**每个**模块都会触发一次 `_keep_in_fp32`，但模式带了 `^<module_name>\.` 前缀，中间模块跑完时只会转换自己子树里「列表可见」的部分；最外层跑完时完成剩余的全量转换。幂等性由 `keep_tensors_in_fp32` 的「已是 fp32 就跳过」保证。

200	### 4.3 stage3 按分区 dtype 的子组与梯度缓冲
201	
202	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
203	
204	分区转成 fp32 只是第一步。ZeRO-3 优化器的整套簿记原本假设「一个模型一种 dtype」：参数组会被压平进单一 dtype 的平坦缓冲、梯度分区落进单一缓冲、`self.dtype` 直接取自参数。#8843 对 `DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3` 做了四处结构性改造：
205	
206	1. **训练 dtype 的判定**：`self.dtype` 不再「看参数是什么就是什么」——如果所有可训练参数恰好都是保真 fp32 参数（例如全冻结的 bf16 模型 + 点名的 fp32 参数），直接取参数 dtype 会把训练 dtype 误判成 fp32。现在引擎显式传 `model_dtype`；未传时取「第一个非 fp32 的参数 dtype，全 fp32 则取第一个」。
207	2. **子组按分区 dtype 拆分**：一个子组要压平进一块缓冲，一块缓冲只能一种 dtype——保真 fp32 参数自成子组。`lp_param_buffers` 变成 `Dict[torch.dtype, Tensor]`。
208	3. **梯度缓冲按累积 dtype 分桶**：`grad_partitions_flat_buffers` 变成 `Dict[torch.dtype, Tensor]`——保真参数的梯度在 fp32 缓冲里累积，其余参数用配置的 `gradient_accumulation_dtype`。
209	4. **参数卸载直接拒绝**：卸载路径的 CPU 平坦缓冲是单 dtype 的，多 dtype 时在布局阶段抛 `NotImplementedError`。
210	
211	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
212	
213	```
214	引擎 _configure_zero_optimizer
215	  └─ DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3(..., model_dtype=bf16, gradient_accumulation_dtype=...)
216	        │
217	        ├─ self.dtype = model_dtype（或第一个非 fp32 参数 dtype）
218	        │
219	        ├─ _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation
220	        │     └─ _create_fp16_sub_groups(参数组)
221	        │           └─ _split_by_partition_dtype：按 ds_tensor.dtype 分桶，
222	        │              每桶再按 sub_group_size 切 → 子组 = 一块缓冲一种 dtype
223	        │     ├─ 无参数卸载：lp_param_buffers[dtype] = defragment(该 dtype 的分区)
224	        │     │    fp16_partitioned_groups_flat 每段 narrow 自对应 dtype 的缓冲
225	        │     └─ 有参数卸载且分区 dtype > 1 种 → NotImplementedError
226	        │
227	        └─ _setup_for_real_optimizer
228	              ├─ IPG 桶按 dtype 定容（见 4.4）
229	              └─ grad_partitions_flat_buffers[dtype] = zeros(该桶参数的分区总量)
230	                   每个参数的梯度分区 = 对应缓冲的 narrow 视图
231	                   （__param_id_to_grad_partition 映射）
232	溢出检查 has_overflow：遍历全部 dtype 的梯度缓冲
233	```
234

273	### 4.4 按 dtype 的 IPG 桶与 all-reduce 取回拆分
274	
275	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
276	
277	梯度反向的路径也要认识 dtype：
278	
279	- **IPG 桶（reduce 路径）**：stage3 为每种「通信 dtype」各建一个桶。保真参数的梯度用 **fp32** 归约——如果按惯例舍到 bf16 再归约，恰好抵消了保留 fp32 的意义（归约中的舍入与 bf16 累加都会吃掉那 1e-4 量级的差异）。
280	- **取回路径（fetch）**：`use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params` 开启时参数用 all-reduce 取回；一次 all-reduce 只能有一种 dtype，混合分桶时按 dtype 拆成多个子调用，包进 `MultipleAllGatherHandles`。
281	
282	还有一个精巧的细节：**纯 fp32 桶可以缩小容量**。桶容量默认是 `reduce_bucket_size`；一个桶里如果**全部**参数都是保真参数，容量收缩到 `min(reduce_bucket_size, 这些参数的总元素数)`。混合桶不能这么做——原因写在了代码注释里：backward 中途抛异常会把桶里的梯度留到 `step()`，重试的 backward 会把同一批参数再加进桶，容量刚好等于参数总量会装满并在桶里出现同一参数两次。
283	
284	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
285	
286	```
287	反向：param.grad 就绪
288	  └─ reduce_independent_p_g_buckets_and_remove_grads(param)
289	       comm_dtype = get_param_comm_dtype(param)
290	         · 保真参数（self.dtype != fp32 且 ds_tensor.dtype == fp32）→ torch.float32
291	         · 其余 → 父类逻辑（communication_data_type / autocast / 参数自带 comm dtype）
292	       bucket = ipg_buckets[comm_dtype]        ← 按 dtype 选桶
293	       桶满（或跨进程组）→ __reduce_and_partition_ipg_grads(comm_dtype)
294	                            → 梯度分区写入对应 dtype 的 grad_partitions_flat_buffer
295	
296	取回：use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params=True
297	  └─ _all_gather_coalesced(params, ...)
298	       dtypes = {p.ds_tensor.dtype for p in params}
299	       len(dtypes) > 1 → 按 dtype 递归拆分，每个 dtype 一块平坦缓冲 + 一次 all_reduce
300	                         → MultipleAllGatherHandles([...])
301	       len(dtypes) == 1 → 单块缓冲一次 all_reduce → AllReduceCoalescedHandle
302	```
303	
304	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
305	
306	三个判定函数 [stage3.py:1640-1654](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1640-L1654)：
307	
308	- `_is_kept_in_fp32`：`self.dtype != torch.float32 and param.ds_tensor.dtype == torch.float32`——「训练 dtype 是低精度，而这个参数的分区是 fp32」即保真参数；
309	- `get_param_comm_dtype`：保真参数返回 `torch.float32`，注释直说「为归约把梯度舍到 bf16 会抵消保留它的意义」；
310	- `_grad_accumulation_dtype`：保真参数返回 fp32（决定它落在哪块梯度缓冲，见 4.3）。
311	
312	IPG 桶的创建 [stage3.py:481-490](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L481-L490)：通信 dtype 集合 = autocast 场景下所有参数的 comm dtype（或配置的 `communication_data_type`），再并入每个参数的 `get_param_comm_dtype`；`ipg_buckets` 是 `Dict[torch.dtype, IPGBucketZ3]`。
313

333	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
334	
335	**练习 1**：把保真参数的梯度按 `communication_data_type`（例如 bf16）归约会发生什么？
336	**答案**：梯度先被舍到 bf16 网格（8.0 附近间隔 0.0625），归约后的和再舍一次——两个微批间 1e-4 量级的差异被彻底抹掉，`test_kept_param_gradient_is_fp32` 的逐位相等断言会失败。这就是 `get_param_comm_dtype` 对保真参数强制返回 fp32 的原因。
337	
338	**练习 2**：为什么纯 fp32 桶可以按参数总量收缩容量，而「fp32+bf16 混住的桶」不能？
339	**答案**：桶容量只约束「何时触发 reduce」。混合桶保持 `reduce_bucket_size` 是因为异常中断的 backward 会把梯度留在桶里直到 step()，重试的 backward 会把同一批参数再次入桶；容量等于参数总量会让桶立即装满并出现重复参数。而纯保真参数的桶……其实同样面临重试，但由于保真参数通常很少（路由 bias、sink 等），收缩后桶也只是变小，重复入桶的空间仍由「桶满才 reduce」的触发条件兜底——代码注释给出的正是这层权衡，混合桶保守、纯桶激进。
340	
341	**练习 3**：`MultipleAllGatherHandles` 里的多个句柄是串行还是并行完成的？
342	**答案**：每个子调用各自发起 `async_op=True` 的集合通信后立即返回句柄，多个 dtype 的 all_reduce 在各自流上重叠执行，等待时统一 join——这正是拆分成多句柄而非串行拼接的意义。

344	### 4.5 引擎侧能力判定与拒绝矩阵
345	
346	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
347	
348	最后一环是引擎的「能力判定」：**只有 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载**的配置才能让点名参数留在 fp32。原因在 `BF16_Optimizer`、ZeRO-1/2 优化器里，每个优化器参数组被压平成**一块单 dtype 缓冲**；卸载的 ZeRO-3 模型分区也躺在单 dtype 的 CPU/NVMe 缓冲里。这些路径遇到「点名参数」只能把它 cast 到训练 dtype：
349	
350	- `"auto"` 模式：`logger.warning`（模型自己的列表，用户没有显式要求，不该硬失败）；
351	- 显式列表：直接 `ValueError`（用户明确点名了参数，静默降级等于撒谎）。
352	
353	buffers 在**所有**配置下都保 fp32（它们从不参与优化器压平）。
354	
355	完整的拒绝矩阵：
356	
357	| 配置 | 点名参数 | 点名 buffers |
358	| --- | --- | --- |
359	| ZeRO-3，无参数卸载 | **fp32 保留**，梯度 fp32 归约累积 | fp32 |
360	| ZeRO-3 + `offload_param`（cpu/nvme） | 训练 dtype，Init 收尾告警一次 | fp32 |
361	| ZeRO-0/1/2，或 bf16/fp16 优化器路径 | 训练 dtype；auto 告警 / 显式列表 `ValueError` | fp32 |
362	| ZeRO-3 多 dtype + `offload_states(include=[lp_params 或 lp_grads])` | `NotImplementedError`（`hp_params` 可单独移动） | 同左 |
363	| 冻结参数 + `zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights` | 保持 int8 量化，`warning_once` | — |
364	
365	两个 stage3 变体做了机械适配：SuperOffload 覆写 `_create_fp16_sub_groups` 先按 dtype 拆分；zenflow 的 `partition_grads` 经由按 dtype 的 `__param_id_to_grad_partition` 把每个梯度分区落进自己 dtype 的缓冲。
366	
367	#### 4.5.2 核心流程
368	
369	```
370	引擎 _configure_distributed_model（fp16/bf16 启用时）
371	  keep_pattern = keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, config.keep_in_fp32_modules, param_dtype)
372	  _cast_module_mixed_precision(param_dtype, buffer_dtype, is_zero_init_model,
373	                               keep_pattern, keep_params=_keeps_params_in_fp32())
374	      │
375	      ├─ kept = 点名张量集合（buffers，或 buffers+参数）
376	      ├─ 非 zero-init：逐参数 cast 到 param_dtype，跳过 kept
377	      ├─ keep_tensors_in_fp32(...)：点名张量上转 fp32
378	      │    （zero-init 路径下这一步转的是分区——引擎是分区转换的第二道防线）
379	      ├─ keep_params=False 且点名命中了参数 → _warn_listed_params_not_kept
380	      │    · 显式列表 → ValueError
381	      │    · auto → logger.warning
382	      └─ buffer_dtype cast 跳过 kept
383	```
384	
385	`_keeps_params_in_fp32()` = `zero_optimization_partition_weights()`（即 stage 3）且 `offload_param.device` 不是 cpu/nvme。它是整套判定的单一事实来源：`zero.Init` 侧的卸载告警（4.2）与引擎侧的告警/报错（本节）都源于同一条物理约束。

423	#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案
424	
425	**练习 1**：为什么 auto 模式只告警、显式列表却报错？
426	**答案**：auto 的列表来自模型（transformers 类属性），用户未必知道它的存在，硬失败会把大量既有配置挡在门外；显式列表是用户亲手写的意图，静默把它降到训练 dtype 会让用户误以为参数真的在 fp32 里训练。**失败要响亮，降级要可见**。
427	
428	**练习 2**：ZeRO-2（`DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer`）为什么结构上保不住 fp32 参数？
429	**答案**：它把每个优化器参数组的 fp32 主权重压平成单块平坦缓冲（u5-l3 讲过的 `single_partition_of_fp32_groups`），一块缓冲一种 dtype；要保 fp32 参数就得把整组拆成两种缓冲，等于重做 stage3 的这套改造——所以引擎直接判定「不可保留」。
430	
431	**练习 3**：`_cast_module_mixed_precision` 里为什么 zero-init 路径跳过逐参数 cast、却仍调用 `keep_tensors_in_fp32`？
432	**答案**：zero-init 下参数在 `zero.Init` 里已经按配置 dtype 分区完毕，再逐参数 cast 反而会破坏分区占位符结构；但**非 zero-init 构建 + ZeRO-3 训练**（先建普通模型再 `deepspeed.initialize`，优化器构造时才切分）的点名参数转换只能由引擎完成——`keep_tensors_in_fp32` 此时作用在完整张量上（此时还没有 `ds_tensor`，转换的就是 `tensor.data` 本身），两条构建路径因此都能得到 fp32 参数。

476	```
477	
478	**验收清单**（每项对应本讲一个模块）：④ 打印出两种分区 dtype 与分 dtype 的梯度缓冲（4.3）；训练无 NaN 且 ⑤ 的偏移大于 5e-4——小于 bf16 分辨率的更新存活（4.3/4.4）；`engine.module.router_bias.dtype == torch.float32`（4.1/4.2）。有条件时再接 `engine.save_checkpoint` / 新引擎 `load_checkpoint` 往返（对照 `test_checkpoint_round_trip`），以及把 `stage` 改成 2 观察 ValueError（4.5）。运行结果待本地验证。
479	
480	## 6. 本讲小结
481	
482	- **数值根因**：bf16 在 \( v \) 附近的可分辨间隔是 \( v \times 2^{-8} \)；GLM-5.2 路由 bias 的值彼此相差 < 0.01，bf16 直接改变 token 路由。`data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`（默认 `"auto"`）对接 transformers 的 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict` / `_keep_in_fp32_modules`。
483	- **转换在分区上、在收尾时**：`zero.Init` 在每个模块 `__init__` 跑完（列表完整、子模块已分区、检查点未加载）调用 `keep_tensors_in_fp32`，就地把点名参数的 `ds_tensor`（及 hpZ 的 `ds_secondary_tensor`）与 buffers 转 fp32；量化分区保持量化并告警。
484	- **stage3 的四处结构性改造**：训练 dtype 由引擎传入（全保真参数也不误判）；子组按分区 dtype 拆分（`_split_by_partition_dtype`，一子组一缓冲一 dtype）；梯度缓冲按累积 dtype 分桶（保真参数在 fp32 缓冲累积）；溢出检查遍历全部 dtype 缓冲。
485	- **通信路径认 dtype**：保真参数的梯度用 fp32 归约（`get_param_comm_dtype`），纯 fp32 IPG 桶可按参数总量收缩容量；all-reduce 取回按 dtype 拆成 `MultipleAllGatherHandles`。
486	- **能力判定与拒绝矩阵**：仅 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载可保参数 fp32；其余 cast 到训练 dtype（auto 告警 / 显式列表 ValueError）；参数卸载仅保 buffers；`offload_states` 对多 dtype 的 `lp_params`/`lp_grads` 抛 NotImplementedError；superoffload/zenflow 按同一套拆分做了适配。
487	
488	## 7. 下一步学习建议
489	
490	- **u5-l2（zero.Init）**：若你跳过了 Init 的分区机制（padding、`ds_numel_aligned`、句柄家族），回头补齐——本讲的分区转换完全建立在它之上。
491	- **u5-l6（stage3 主循环）**：本讲只改了缓冲的「分桶」，step 的时序（IPG flush → 溢出检查 → 逐子组更新 → 写回）在 u5-l6；两讲对照读 `stage3.py` 收益最大。
492	- **u4-l3（BF16 优化器）**：理解「单 dtype 平坦缓冲」为什么是 ZeRO-0/1/2 与 BF16_Optimizer 保不住 fp32 参数的结构性原因。
493	- **延伸阅读**：`deepspeed/runtime/torch_autocast.py` 的 `sort_dtypes`/`get_all_comm_dtypes`（autocast 与混合 dtype 的交汇点）；`tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py` 全文——它就是这份机制的行为规格说明。

# ZeRO-3 混合 dtype：keep_in_fp32_modules 让点名参数留在 fp32

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说清「为什么 bf16 训练里有些张量必须留在 fp32」：不是精度洁癖，而是 bf16 的尾数位在特定数值区间根本分辨不开相邻的合法值（例如 GLM-5.2 路由 bias 的 256 个值在 bf16 下只剩 3~16 个不同值）。
2. 追踪 `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`（默认 `"auto"`）如何对接 transformers 的 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict` / `_keep_in_fp32_modules` 两张列表，`keep_tensors_in_fp32()` 如何在 `zero.Init` 收尾时就地把点名参数的 `ds_tensor` 分区转为 fp32。
3. 理解 ZeRO-3 优化器（`DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3`）为支撑「一个模型、多种分区 dtype」所做的四处改造：按分区 dtype 拆子组、按累积 dtype 分平坦梯度缓冲、按通信 dtype 分 IPG 桶（含纯 fp32 桶的容量收缩）、按 dtype 拆分 all-reduce 取回。
4. 复述完整的能力判定与拒绝矩阵：什么配置下参数能保 fp32（仅 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载），什么时候退化为「参数 cast 到训练 dtype + 告警」，什么时候直接 `ValueError` / `NotImplementedError`。

本讲对应 PR #8843，是把 `keep_in_fp32_modules` 从「只保 buffers」扩展到「参数与 buffers 都保」的完整机制解读。

## 2. 前置知识

- **bf16 的分辨间隔**：bf16 有 8 位指数、7 位有效尾数（含隐含 1）。在数值 \( v \) 附近，两个可分辨的 bf16 值至少相距 \( v \times 2^{-8} \)（相对分辨率 \( 2^{-7} \approx 0.78\% \)）。在 \( v = 8 \) 附近，间隔是 \( 8 \times 2^{-8} = 0.0625 \)。fp32 有 23 位尾数，同样位置间隔约 \( 8 \times 2^{-24} \approx 4.8 \times 10^{-7} \)。所以「值域正常但彼此太接近」的一组数，bf16 会整批舍到同一个网格点。
- **transformers 的两张 fp32 列表**：`_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`（bf16 与 fp16 训练下都保 fp32）和 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`（仅 fp16 下保 fp32）。transformers 自己加载模型时会尊重它们；典型被点名的张量是 MoE 路由 bias `e_score_correction_bias`（DeepSeek-V3、GLM-4.5/GLM-5 等，buffer）、DeepSeek-V4 的超连接权重/attention sinks/norms、gpt-oss 的 attention sinks（参数）。
- **ZeRO-3 与 zero.Init**（见 u5-l2）：`zero.Init` patch `nn.Module.__init__`，子模块构造完成的瞬间就把参数切分成各 rank 的 `ds_tensor` 分区，`param.data` 变成 0 元素占位符。本讲的转换正是发生在这些分区上。
- **ZeRO-3 优化器的平坦缓冲**（见 u5-l6）：优化器把参数分区搬进连续平坦缓冲（`lp_param_buffers` / `fp16_partitioned_groups_flat`），梯度分区落在 `grad_partitions_flat_buffers`，反向梯度经 IPG 桶 reduce-scatter。#8843 之前这些结构都假设「单一 dtype」。
- **核心矛盾**：`zero.Init` 会把 `__init__` 里创建的每个浮点张量转成训练 dtype，之后 transformers 的 ZeRO-3 加载器把检查点值拷进这些张量——于是 transformers 的 fp32 列表在 ZeRO-3 下被无声丢弃。本讲讲的整套机制就是把它找回来。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| [deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py) | 模式匹配与就地转换的核心：`keep_in_fp32_pattern` / `tensors_to_keep_in_fp32` / `keep_tensors_in_fp32` |
| [deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py) | `zero.Init`：读取配置、在 `_post_init_method` 收尾与 `module=` 两条路径上调用 `_keep_in_fp32`；`_all_gather_coalesced` 按 dtype 拆分 all-reduce 取回 |
| [deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py) | ZeRO-3 优化器的混合 dtype 支撑：子组拆分、平坦缓冲、IPG 桶、溢出检查、`offload_states` 拒绝 |
| [deepspeed/runtime/engine.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py) | 引擎侧能力判定 `_keeps_params_in_fp32`、混合精度 cast 时的保留、`model_dtype` 传递 |
| [deepspeed/runtime/config.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/config.py) | `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules` 的解析与类型校验 |
| [docs/_pages/config-json.md](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/docs/_pages/config-json.md) | 该配置项的用户文档（行为契约的权威表述） |
| [tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py) | 全部行为的回归测试，也是本讲代码实践的蓝本 |
| [deepspeed/runtime/superoffload/superoffload_stage3.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/superoffload/superoffload_stage3.py) 与 [deepspeed/runtime/zenflow/engine_stage3.py](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zenflow/engine_stage3.py) | 两个 stage3 变体对多 dtype 的机械适配 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 keep_in_fp32 的模式匹配与就地转换（参数与缓冲）

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

这个模块回答两个问题：**哪些张量被点名**，以及**怎么转**。

配置入口是 `data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`，三种取值：

- `"auto"`（默认）：用模型自己声明的 transformers 列表——`_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict`，加上 fp16 训练时的 `_keep_in_fp32_modules`；
- 一个模式字符串列表：`*` 代表任意字符，且模式可以匹配参数/缓冲全名的任意位置（与 transformers 的匹配规则一致）；
- `[]`：什么都不保（回到该选项存在之前的行为）。

模块文件头部的 docstring 把动机写得很直白，值得一读：GLM-5.2 的 `e_score_correction_bias` 值落在 5~20 之间、彼此相差不到 0.01，而 bf16 在该区间只能分辨 0.03~0.125 的差异，于是 256 个专家只剩 3~16 个不同值，**直接改变 token 被送去哪个专家**。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```
JSON data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules
        │
        ▼
keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, setting, dtype)   ← 编译出正则或 None
  · dtype 是 fp32 训练 → None（无需保留）
  · "auto"：遍历 module.named_modules()，
    收集每个子模块的 _keep_in_fp32_modules_strict（+ fp16 下的 _keep_in_fp32_modules）
    每个名字：'*'→'.*'，并加前缀 ^<module_name>\..*<pattern>
  · 列表：'{name}' → '{name 的 * 换成 .*}'
  · 无模式 → None
        │
        ▼
tensors_to_keep_in_fp32(module, pattern)       ← 枚举命中者
  遍历每个模块的本地参数与缓冲（recurse=False 逐层拼前缀），
  过滤 is_floating_point() 且 pattern.search(全名)
  产出 (全名, 张量, 是否 buffer) 列表
        │
        ▼
keep_tensors_in_fp32(module, pattern, include_params=True)   ← 就地转 fp32
  对每个命中张量：
    · 量化分区（有 ds_quant_scale）→ 保持量化，warning_once，跳过
    · 存储 dtype 已是 fp32 → 跳过
    · ZeRO-3 参数：ds_tensor.data = ds_tensor.data.float()
      （hpZ 的 ds_secondary_tensor 一并转；tensor.data 占位符也转，
       保证后续 gather/free 的 dtype 一致）
    · buffer：tensor.data = tensor.data.float()
  返回 (转换的参数数, 转换的缓冲数)
```

为什么转分区而不只是转 `param.data`？因为 ZeRO-3 参数的真数据躺在 `ds_tensor` 分区里，`param.data` 只是 0 元素占位符（gather 状态下才是全量张量）。只转占位符等于什么都没做；转了分区，后续 all-gather 出来的就是 fp32，检查点加载也会写入精确的 fp32 值。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

配置解析与校验在 [deepspeed/runtime/config.py:559-571](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/config.py#L559-L571)：读取 `data_types` 块的 `keep_in_fp32_modules`，非 `"auto"` 且不是纯字符串列表时抛 `DeepSpeedConfigError`。

模式编译 [deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py:39-62](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L39-L62)：训练 dtype 不是 fp16/bf16 直接返回 `None`；`auto` 模式遍历 `named_modules()` 收集两张 transformers 列表，每个名字按所属模块路径加前缀，最后 `re.compile("|".join(sorted(patterns)))`——注释指明这与 transformers 的 `core_model_loading.build_glob_alternation` + `re.search` 是同一条规则。

关键点：前缀是 `^{module_name}\..*{pattern}`。列表挂在哪个子模块上，就只匹配那个子模块子树里的名字——测试 `WrappedToyModel` 里 `other_child.inner.router_bias` 不被命中，正是因为列表挂在 `child` 上。

枚举与就地转换 [deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py:65-120](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L65-L120)，其中 `keep_tensors_in_fp32` 的主体在 [L85-L120](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L85-L120)：

- [L97-L102](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L97-L102)：分区带 `ds_quant_scale`（`zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights` 存的是 int8 码 + scale）时保持量化并 `warning_once`——把 int8 码直接 `.float()` 得到的是码值而不是权重值，scale 也就对不上了。
- [L105-L115](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L105-L115)：`partition.data = partition.data.float()` 就地转分区；hpZ 场景下 `ds_secondary_tensor`（节点内第二副本）同步转换；最后 `tensor.data = tensor.data.float()` 转占位符或当前 gather 出来的全量张量，使下一次 gather 与 free 都保持 fp32。

用户文档对整个行为契约的表述在 [docs/_pages/config-json.md:1794-1798](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/docs/_pages/config-json.md#L1794-L1798)。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：用 5 行代码亲眼看到 bf16 网格塌缩，再验证模式匹配规则。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 在仓库根目录运行（纯 CPU，无需分布式）：

     ```bash
     python -c "
     import torch
     v = 8.0 + torch.arange(64, dtype=torch.float32) * 1e-4
     print(v.bfloat16().float().unique())   # 64 个值在 bf16 下剩几个？
     "
     ```

   - 再跑模式匹配单测：

     ```bash
     pytest tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py::TestKeepInFp32Pattern -v
     ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：第一个命令输出只有一个值 `8.0`（或极少数几个）；第二个命令里 `test_auto_uses_lists_from_nested_modules` 等用例通过。
4. **预期结果**：`v` 彼此相差 1e-4，远小于 8.0 处 bf16 的间隔 0.0625，所以 64 个值全部舍到 8.0——这正是 `EXACT_VALUES`（[test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py:23-24](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py#L23-L24)）选择这组值的原因：任何 fp32 信息的丢失都会立刻表现为「值落在 bf16 网格点上」。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `keep_in_fp32_pattern` 在 dtype 为 `torch.float32` 时返回 `None`？
**答案**：fp32 训练下所有张量本来就是 fp32，无需保留任何名单；返回 `None` 让所有调用方直接短路（见 `zero.Init._keep_in_fp32` 与引擎 cast 路径的判空）。

**练习 2**：`_keep_in_fp32_modules`（不带 `_strict`）的列表在什么条件下参与匹配？
**答案**：仅当训练 dtype 是 fp16 时（[keep_in_fp32.py:50-51](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/keep_in_fp32.py#L50-L51)）。bf16 指数位与 fp32 相同、动态范围完整，transformers 认为这些张量在 bf16 下不必保 fp32；fp16 会溢出，所以两张表都要。

**练习 3**：如果一个被点名的 ZeRO-3 参数同时开了 `zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights` 且被冻结，转换后它是什么形态？
**答案**：保持量化（int8 码 + `ds_quant_scale`），打印一条 `warning_once`；因为把码转成 fp32 并不能还原权重值，反而让 scale 失配。对应测试 `TestZeroInitKeepsQuantizedParams`。

### 4.2 zero.Init 的收尾转换钩子

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

转换的**时机**是这套机制里最讲究的部分。`zero.Init` 在每个子模块构造完成的瞬间就切分了它的参数，那 fp32 转换插在哪里？答案是两条路径：

1. **在线构建**（`with deepspeed.zero.Init(...): model = Model()`）：挂在 `_post_init_method` 末尾——即「模块自身 `__init__` 刚跑完」的钩子。对 transformers 模型，最外层模型 `__init__` 跑完时，它的 fp32 列表才完整（列表可能是 `__init__` 里设置的实例属性）、所有子模块已分区，而任何检查点还没加载——这是唯一能把「点名参数的分区」整体转 fp32 的窗口。
2. **已分配模型**（`deepspeed.zero.Init(module=model, ...)`）：`_convert_to_zero_parameters` 切分完直接调用。

参数卸载（`remote_device` 是 cpu/nvme）时只保 buffers：卸载分区躺在单一 dtype 的平坦 CPU/NVMe 缓冲里（见 4.3 的拒绝矩阵），无法逐参数换 dtype。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```
with zero.Init(config):                 │  zero.Init(module=model, config)
  Model.__init__ 逐层执行                │  _convert_to_zero_parameters(model)
  每个子模块 __init__ 结束 →             │        │
  _post_init_method(module):            │        ▼
    · 子参数 → _zero_init_param 分区     │  _keep_in_fp32(model)
    · _keep_in_fp32(module)  ←──────────┼──────┘
        pattern = keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, config 值, dtype)
        pattern 为 None → return
        params_offloaded = remote_device != local_device
        keep_tensors_in_fp32(module, pattern,
                             include_params=not params_offloaded)
        params_offloaded → warning（只保 buffers），每个 Init 进程只警告一次
```

注意 `_post_init_method` 对**每个**模块都会触发一次 `_keep_in_fp32`，但模式带了 `^<module_name>\.` 前缀，中间模块跑完时只会转换自己子树里「列表可见」的部分；最外层跑完时完成剩余的全量转换。幂等性由 `keep_tensors_in_fp32` 的「已是 fp32 就跳过」保证。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**练习 1**：为什么转换不放在 `deepspeed.initialize` 里、而要放在每个模块 `__init__` 的收尾？

**练习 2**：`Init._warned_keep_in_fp32_offload` 为什么挂在类上而不是实例上？
**答案**：一个进程可能建多个模型/多次进出 `zero.Init`；卸载场景下告警是全局性的（参数分区注定单 dtype），类级标记避免每个模型重复刷屏，同时保留「至少警告一次」的可见性。

### 4.3 stage3 按分区 dtype 的子组与梯度缓冲

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

分区转成 fp32 只是第一步。ZeRO-3 优化器的整套簿记原本假设「一个模型一种 dtype」：参数组会被压平进单一 dtype 的平坦缓冲、梯度分区落进单一缓冲、`self.dtype` 直接取自参数。#8843 对 `DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3` 做了四处结构性改造：

1. **训练 dtype 的判定**：`self.dtype` 不再「看参数是什么就是什么」——如果所有可训练参数恰好都是保真 fp32 参数（例如全冻结的 bf16 模型 + 点名的 fp32 参数），直接取参数 dtype 会把训练 dtype 误判成 fp32。现在引擎显式传 `model_dtype`；未传时取「第一个非 fp32 的参数 dtype，全 fp32 则取第一个」。
2. **子组按分区 dtype 拆分**：一个子组要压平进一块缓冲，一块缓冲只能一种 dtype——保真 fp32 参数自成子组。`lp_param_buffers` 变成 `Dict[torch.dtype, Tensor]`。
3. **梯度缓冲按累积 dtype 分桶**：`grad_partitions_flat_buffers` 变成 `Dict[torch.dtype, Tensor]`——保真参数的梯度在 fp32 缓冲里累积，其余参数用配置的 `gradient_accumulation_dtype`。
4. **参数卸载直接拒绝**：卸载路径的 CPU 平坦缓冲是单 dtype 的，多 dtype 时在布局阶段抛 `NotImplementedError`。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
引擎 _configure_zero_optimizer
  └─ DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer_Stage3(..., model_dtype=bf16, gradient_accumulation_dtype=...)
        │
        ├─ self.dtype = model_dtype（或第一个非 fp32 参数 dtype）
        │
        ├─ _create_fp16_partitions_with_defragmentation
        │     └─ _create_fp16_sub_groups(参数组)
        │           └─ _split_by_partition_dtype：按 ds_tensor.dtype 分桶，
        │              每桶再按 sub_group_size 切 → 子组 = 一块缓冲一种 dtype
        │     ├─ 无参数卸载：lp_param_buffers[dtype] = defragment(该 dtype 的分区)
        │     │    fp16_partitioned_groups_flat 每段 narrow 自对应 dtype 的缓冲
        │     └─ 有参数卸载且分区 dtype > 1 种 → NotImplementedError
        │
        └─ _setup_for_real_optimizer
              ├─ IPG 桶按 dtype 定容（见 4.4）
              └─ grad_partitions_flat_buffers[dtype] = zeros(该桶参数的分区总量)
                   每个参数的梯度分区 = 对应缓冲的 narrow 视图
                   （__param_id_to_grad_partition 映射）
溢出检查 has_overflow：遍历全部 dtype 的梯度缓冲
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

训练 dtype 判定 [deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py:234-239](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L234-L239)：`model_dtype` 为 `None` 时用生成器取第一个非 fp32 的参数 dtype。引擎侧在 [engine.py:2856](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/engine.py#L2856) 显式传入（`model_dtype` 来自 `get_data_types()`，由 bf16/fp16 开关决定）。

子组拆分 [stage3.py:1259-1270](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1259-L1270)：`_split_by_partition_dtype` 按 `param.ds_tensor.dtype` 用 `defaultdict(list)` 分桶并以 `sort_dtypes`（按 dtype 名字符串排序，保证各 rank 顺序一致）返回；`_create_fp16_sub_groups` 发现多于一种 dtype 就递归地对每桶分别建组。

平坦参数缓冲按 dtype 分桶 [stage3.py:1000-1011](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1000-L1011)：`defragment` 一次只能处理一种 dtype，所以保真 fp32 参数拿到自己的缓冲；`lp_param_buffer` 指向训练 dtype 那块（不存在则第一块）。子组的平坦段由 [_set_fp16_partitioned_groups_flat, stage3.py:1357-1367](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1357-L1367) 从对应 dtype 的缓冲里 `narrow` 出来，每个 dtype 维护独立的写偏移。

参数卸载的拒绝 [stage3.py:1013-1016](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1013-L1016)：`_partition_dtypes()`（[L1656-L1657](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1656-L1657)，收集全部分区 dtype 的有序列表）多于一种且走卸载分支时抛 `NotImplementedError`——与 4.2 的「卸载只保 buffers」首尾呼应：Init 收尾时 `include_params=False`，根本不会产生 fp32 分区，这里是防御性兜底。

梯度缓冲按累积 dtype 分桶 [stage3.py:816-835](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L816-L835)：`_grad_accumulation_dtype(param)`（[L1651-L1654](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1651-L1654)）对保真参数返回 fp32、其余返回配置值；每个 dtype 一块 `torch.zeros` 缓冲（卸载时 pin），参数的梯度分区是各自缓冲的 `narrow` 视图，登记进 `__param_id_to_grad_partition`。`grad_partitions_flat_buffer` 指向主累积 dtype 那块。

溢出检查遍历全部缓冲 [stage3.py:3240-3253](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L3240-L3253)：`has_overflow` 对 `grad_partitions_flat_buffers.values()` 逐块做 isinf/isnan 归约——注释点明「每个梯度 dtype 一块缓冲，保真参数有自己的那块」，漏查任何一块都会让 fp32 缓冲里的溢出逃过检查。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`_split_by_partition_dtype` 为什么要用 `sort_dtypes`（按名字符串排序）而不是直接迭代 dict？

**答案**：是引擎传入的 `model_dtype`（bf16）。若引擎没传，`next((d for d in param_dtypes if d != torch.float32), ...)` 会跳过 fp32 找到 bf16 的冻结权重——这正是注释「优化器的参数在全是保真参数时不显示训练 dtype」要处理的场景。

### 4.4 按 dtype 的 IPG 桶与 all-reduce 取回拆分

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

梯度反向的路径也要认识 dtype：

- **IPG 桶（reduce 路径）**：stage3 为每种「通信 dtype」各建一个桶。保真参数的梯度用 **fp32** 归约——如果按惯例舍到 bf16 再归约，恰好抵消了保留 fp32 的意义（归约中的舍入与 bf16 累加都会吃掉那 1e-4 量级的差异）。
- **取回路径（fetch）**：`use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params` 开启时参数用 all-reduce 取回；一次 all-reduce 只能有一种 dtype，混合分桶时按 dtype 拆成多个子调用，包进 `MultipleAllGatherHandles`。

还有一个精巧的细节：**纯 fp32 桶可以缩小容量**。桶容量默认是 `reduce_bucket_size`；一个桶里如果**全部**参数都是保真参数，容量收缩到 `min(reduce_bucket_size, 这些参数的总元素数)`。混合桶不能这么做——原因写在了代码注释里：backward 中途抛异常会把桶里的梯度留到 `step()`，重试的 backward 会把同一批参数再加进桶，容量刚好等于参数总量会装满并在桶里出现同一参数两次。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```
反向：param.grad 就绪
  └─ reduce_independent_p_g_buckets_and_remove_grads(param)
       comm_dtype = get_param_comm_dtype(param)
         · 保真参数（self.dtype != fp32 且 ds_tensor.dtype == fp32）→ torch.float32
         · 其余 → 父类逻辑（communication_data_type / autocast / 参数自带 comm dtype）
       bucket = ipg_buckets[comm_dtype]        ← 按 dtype 选桶
       桶满（或跨进程组）→ __reduce_and_partition_ipg_grads(comm_dtype)
                            → 梯度分区写入对应 dtype 的 grad_partitions_flat_buffer

取回：use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params=True
  └─ _all_gather_coalesced(params, ...)
       dtypes = {p.ds_tensor.dtype for p in params}
       len(dtypes) > 1 → 按 dtype 递归拆分，每个 dtype 一块平坦缓冲 + 一次 all_reduce
                         → MultipleAllGatherHandles([...])
       len(dtypes) == 1 → 单块缓冲一次 all_reduce → AllReduceCoalescedHandle
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

三个判定函数 [stage3.py:1640-1654](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1640-L1654)：

- `_is_kept_in_fp32`：`self.dtype != torch.float32 and param.ds_tensor.dtype == torch.float32`——「训练 dtype 是低精度，而这个参数的分区是 fp32」即保真参数；
- `get_param_comm_dtype`：保真参数返回 `torch.float32`，注释直说「为归约把梯度舍到 bf16 会抵消保留它的意义」；
- `_grad_accumulation_dtype`：保真参数返回 fp32（决定它落在哪块梯度缓冲，见 4.3）。

IPG 桶的创建 [stage3.py:481-490](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L481-L490)：通信 dtype 集合 = autocast 场景下所有参数的 comm dtype（或配置的 `communication_data_type`），再并入每个参数的 `get_param_comm_dtype`；`ipg_buckets` 是 `Dict[torch.dtype, IPGBucketZ3]`。

桶容量收缩 [stage3.py:804-814](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L804-L814)：`contiguous_gradients` 开启时逐桶分配缓冲；纯保真参数的桶容量取 `min(reduce_bucket_size, sum(p.ds_numel))`，注释完整解释了「重试的 backward 会让参数进桶两次」的风险。

按 dtype 选桶的反向入口 [stage3.py:1662-1681](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1662-L1681)：`reduce_independent_p_g_buckets_and_remove_grads` 用 `get_param_comm_dtype` 定桶，跨进程组或桶满时按该 dtype flush；[__add_grad_to_ipg_bucket, L1716-L1739](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage3.py#L1716-L1739) 同样按 comm dtype 取桶并把梯度拷进桶缓冲。

all-reduce 取回的 dtype 拆分 [partition_parameters.py:1450-1460](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1450-L1460)：`_all_gather_coalesced` 在 `use_all_reduce_for_fetch_params` 且非量化路径下，发现桶内分区 dtype 多于一种时按 dtype 递归，产出一组 `MultipleAllGatherHandles`（每个 dtype 一块 fp32/bf16 平坦缓冲、一次 `dist.all_reduce`）。常规 all-gather 路径（[L1479-L1490](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/blob/84481c333875abc8a47f1b0d07fdadddb8d70fd8/deepspeed/runtime/zero/partition_parameters.py#L1479-L1490)）同样按 `allgather_dtype` 用 `defaultdict` 分桶后逐 dtype 收集。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：把保真参数的梯度按 `communication_data_type`（例如 bf16）归约会发生什么？
**答案**：梯度先被舍到 bf16 网格（8.0 附近间隔 0.0625），归约后的和再舍一次——两个微批间 1e-4 量级的差异被彻底抹掉，`test_kept_param_gradient_is_fp32` 的逐位相等断言会失败。这就是 `get_param_comm_dtype` 对保真参数强制返回 fp32 的原因。

**练习 2**：为什么纯 fp32 桶可以按参数总量收缩容量，而「fp32+bf16 混住的桶」不能？
**答案**：桶容量只约束「何时触发 reduce」。混合桶保持 `reduce_bucket_size` 是因为异常中断的 backward 会把梯度留在桶里直到 step()，重试的 backward 会把同一批参数再次入桶；容量等于参数总量会让桶立即装满并出现重复参数。而纯保真参数的桶……其实同样面临重试，但由于保真参数通常很少（路由 bias、sink 等），收缩后桶也只是变小，重复入桶的空间仍由「桶满才 reduce」的触发条件兜底——代码注释给出的正是这层权衡，混合桶保守、纯桶激进。

**练习 3**：`MultipleAllGatherHandles` 里的多个句柄是串行还是并行完成的？
**答案**：每个子调用各自发起 `async_op=True` 的集合通信后立即返回句柄，多个 dtype 的 all_reduce 在各自流上重叠执行，等待时统一 join——这正是拆分成多句柄而非串行拼接的意义。

### 4.5 引擎侧能力判定与拒绝矩阵

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

最后一环是引擎的「能力判定」：**只有 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载**的配置才能让点名参数留在 fp32。原因在 `BF16_Optimizer`、ZeRO-1/2 优化器里，每个优化器参数组被压平成**一块单 dtype 缓冲**；卸载的 ZeRO-3 模型分区也躺在单 dtype 的 CPU/NVMe 缓冲里。这些路径遇到「点名参数」只能把它 cast 到训练 dtype：

- `"auto"` 模式：`logger.warning`（模型自己的列表，用户没有显式要求，不该硬失败）；
- 显式列表：直接 `ValueError`（用户明确点名了参数，静默降级等于撒谎）。

buffers 在**所有**配置下都保 fp32（它们从不参与优化器压平）。

完整的拒绝矩阵：

| 配置 | 点名参数 | 点名 buffers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ZeRO-3，无参数卸载 | **fp32 保留**，梯度 fp32 归约累积 | fp32 |
| ZeRO-3 + `offload_param`（cpu/nvme） | 训练 dtype，Init 收尾告警一次 | fp32 |
| ZeRO-0/1/2，或 bf16/fp16 优化器路径 | 训练 dtype；auto 告警 / 显式列表 `ValueError` | fp32 |
| ZeRO-3 多 dtype + `offload_states(include=[lp_params 或 lp_grads])` | `NotImplementedError`（`hp_params` 可单独移动） | 同左 |
| 冻结参数 + `zero_quantized_nontrainable_weights` | 保持 int8 量化，`warning_once` | — |

两个 stage3 变体做了机械适配：SuperOffload 覆写 `_create_fp16_sub_groups` 先按 dtype 拆分；zenflow 的 `partition_grads` 经由按 dtype 的 `__param_id_to_grad_partition` 把每个梯度分区落进自己 dtype 的缓冲。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

```
引擎 _configure_distributed_model（fp16/bf16 启用时）
  keep_pattern = keep_in_fp32_pattern(module, config.keep_in_fp32_modules, param_dtype)
  _cast_module_mixed_precision(param_dtype, buffer_dtype, is_zero_init_model,
                               keep_pattern, keep_params=_keeps_params_in_fp32())
      │
      ├─ kept = 点名张量集合（buffers，或 buffers+参数）
      ├─ 非 zero-init：逐参数 cast 到 param_dtype，跳过 kept
      ├─ keep_tensors_in_fp32(...)：点名张量上转 fp32
      │    （zero-init 路径下这一步转的是分区——引擎是分区转换的第二道防线）
      ├─ keep_params=False 且点名命中了参数 → _warn_listed_params_not_kept
      │    · 显式列表 → ValueError
      │    · auto → logger.warning
      └─ buffer_dtype cast 跳过 kept
```

`_keeps_params_in_fp32()` = `zero_optimization_partition_weights()`（即 stage 3）且 `offload_param.device` 不是 cpu/nvme。它是整套判定的单一事实来源：`zero.Init` 侧的卸载告警（4.2）与引擎侧的告警/报错（本节）都源于同一条物理约束。

#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 auto 模式只告警、显式列表却报错？
**答案**：auto 的列表来自模型（transformers 类属性），用户未必知道它的存在，硬失败会把大量既有配置挡在门外；显式列表是用户亲手写的意图，静默把它降到训练 dtype 会让用户误以为参数真的在 fp32 里训练。**失败要响亮，降级要可见**。

**练习 2**：ZeRO-2（`DeepSpeedZeroOptimizer`）为什么结构上保不住 fp32 参数？
**答案**：它把每个优化器参数组的 fp32 主权重压平成单块平坦缓冲（u5-l3 讲过的 `single_partition_of_fp32_groups`），一块缓冲一种 dtype；要保 fp32 参数就得把整组拆成两种缓冲，等于重做 stage3 的这套改造——所以引擎直接判定「不可保留」。

**练习 3**：`_cast_module_mixed_precision` 里为什么 zero-init 路径跳过逐参数 cast、却仍调用 `keep_tensors_in_fp32`？
**答案**：zero-init 下参数在 `zero.Init` 里已经按配置 dtype 分区完毕，再逐参数 cast 反而会破坏分区占位符结构；但**非 zero-init 构建 + ZeRO-3 训练**（先建普通模型再 `deepspeed.initialize`，优化器构造时才切分）的点名参数转换只能由引擎完成——`keep_tensors_in_fp32` 此时作用在完整张量上（此时还没有 `ds_tensor`，转换的就是 `tensor.data` 本身），两条构建路径因此都能得到 fp32 参数。

## 5. 综合实践

把整条链路串成一个可复用的实验脚本（示例代码，基于 `ToyModelWithParams` 改写，建议放在仓库外运行）：

```python
# keep_fp32_e2e.py —— 贯穿：模式匹配 → zero.Init 收尾转换 → 混合 dtype 训练 → 检查点往返
import torch, deepspeed
from tests.unit.v1.half_precision.test_keep_in_fp32_modules import ToyModelWithParams, EXACT_VALUES, HIDDEN

config = {
    "train_micro_batch_size_per_gpu": 1,
    "gradient_accumulation_steps": 2,
    "optimizer": {"type": "Adam", "params": {"lr": 1e-3}},
    "zero_optimization": {"stage": 3, "stage3_param_persistence_threshold": 0},
    "bf16": {"enabled": True},
    "data_types": {"keep_in_fp32_modules": "auto"},   # ① auto 命中 sink + router_bias
}

with deepspeed.zero.Init(config_dict_or_path=config):    # ② 收尾钩子把 sink 分区转 fp32
    model = ToyModelWithParams()
with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters([model.sink], modifier_rank=0):
    model.sink.data.copy_(EXACT_VALUES)                  # ③ 模拟检查点加载（精确 fp32 值）

engine, _, _, _ = deepspeed.initialize(config=config, model=model,
                                       model_parameters=list(model.parameters()))
opt = engine.optimizer
print("partition dtypes:", opt._partition_dtypes())      # ④ 应为 [bfloat16, float32]
print("sub groups per dtype:", [ [p.ds_id for p in g] for g in opt.fp16_groups ][:4])
print("grad buffers:", {d: b.numel() for d, b in opt.grad_partitions_flat_buffers.items()})

x = torch.randn(1, HIDDEN, device=engine.device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
for _ in range(4):                                       # ⑤ 混合 dtype 训练 2 步（gas=2）
    loss = engine(x); engine.backward(loss); engine.step()
with deepspeed.zero.GatheredParameters([engine.module.sink]):
    print("survived:", (engine.module.sink.data.float() - 8.0).abs().max())  # 应 > 5e-4
```

执行（单机双进程，bf16 在 CPU 加速器上可用；GPU 环境把命令换成 torchrun 等价形式）：

```bash
pytest --no-header -q -s 2>/dev/null || true   # 仅示意；实际用下面方式拉起双进程：
deepspeed --num_gpus 2 keep_fp32_e2e.py 2>/dev/null || torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 keep_fp32_e2e.py
```

**验收清单**（每项对应本讲一个模块）：④ 打印出两种分区 dtype 与分 dtype 的梯度缓冲（4.3）；训练无 NaN 且 ⑤ 的偏移大于 5e-4——小于 bf16 分辨率的更新存活（4.3/4.4）；`engine.module.router_bias.dtype == torch.float32`（4.1/4.2）。有条件时再接 `engine.save_checkpoint` / 新引擎 `load_checkpoint` 往返（对照 `test_checkpoint_round_trip`），以及把 `stage` 改成 2 观察 ValueError（4.5）。运行结果待本地验证。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **数值根因**：bf16 在 \( v \) 附近的可分辨间隔是 \( v \times 2^{-8} \)；GLM-5.2 路由 bias 的值彼此相差 < 0.01，bf16 直接改变 token 路由。`data_types.keep_in_fp32_modules`（默认 `"auto"`）对接 transformers 的 `_keep_in_fp32_modules_strict` / `_keep_in_fp32_modules`。
- **转换在分区上、在收尾时**：`zero.Init` 在每个模块 `__init__` 跑完（列表完整、子模块已分区、检查点未加载）调用 `keep_tensors_in_fp32`，就地把点名参数的 `ds_tensor`（及 hpZ 的 `ds_secondary_tensor`）与 buffers 转 fp32；量化分区保持量化并告警。
- **stage3 的四处结构性改造**：训练 dtype 由引擎传入（全保真参数也不误判）；子组按分区 dtype 拆分（`_split_by_partition_dtype`，一子组一缓冲一 dtype）；梯度缓冲按累积 dtype 分桶（保真参数在 fp32 缓冲累积）；溢出检查遍历全部 dtype 缓冲。
- **通信路径认 dtype**：保真参数的梯度用 fp32 归约（`get_param_comm_dtype`），纯 fp32 IPG 桶可按参数总量收缩容量；all-reduce 取回按 dtype 拆成 `MultipleAllGatherHandles`。
- **能力判定与拒绝矩阵**：仅 ZeRO-3 且无参数卸载可保参数 fp32；其余 cast 到训练 dtype（auto 告警 / 显式列表 ValueError）；参数卸载仅保 buffers；`offload_states` 对多 dtype 的 `lp_params`/`lp_grads` 抛 NotImplementedError；superoffload/zenflow 按同一套拆分做了适配。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **u5-l2（zero.Init）**：若你跳过了 Init 的分区机制（padding、`ds_numel_aligned`、句柄家族），回头补齐——本讲的分区转换完全建立在它之上。
- **u5-l6（stage3 主循环）**：本讲只改了缓冲的「分桶」，step 的时序（IPG flush → 溢出检查 → 逐子组更新 → 写回）在 u5-l6；两讲对照读 `stage3.py` 收益最大。
- **u4-l3（BF16 优化器）**：理解「单 dtype 平坦缓冲」为什么是 ZeRO-0/1/2 与 BF16_Optimizer 保不住 fp32 参数的结构性原因。
- **延伸阅读**：`deepspeed/runtime/torch_autocast.py` 的 `sort_dtypes`/`get_all_comm_dtypes`（autocast 与混合 dtype 的交汇点）；`tests/unit/v1/half_precision/test_keep_in_fp32_modules.py` 全文——它就是这份机制的行为规格说明。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
